caption_L2L3: A large number of methods people have undertaken to prevent Coronavirus infections are presented on this bar chart. The most popular method was to improve personal hygiene, with around 0.7 units. This was followed by avoiding public places at around 0.55 units. The least popular method was to wear a face mask, with around 0.02 units. This was followed by asking doctors for advice, at around 0.04 units.
